stem: Which conclusion about the people of the West is supported by BOTH the article “Pictures of a Disappearing Past” and the poem “Out Where the West Begins”?

options.label: A
options.text: They respected the skills of cowboys.

options.label: B
options.text: They came from many different places.

options.label: C
options.text: They were content about where they lived.

options.label: D
options.text: They valued the natural landscapes of the area.
